chapter_title: THE GUPTA ERA AN AGE OF TIRELESS CREATIVITY

items.title: Who were the Guptas?
items.explanation: The Gupta dynasty emerged in a region near present-day Uttar Pradesh as regional rulers. Over time, they rose to prominence and established a powerful empire that spanned the north and northwest of the subcontinent during the 3rd to 6th centuries CE.

items.title: Why is the Gupta period called the 'classical age'?
items.explanation: The Gupta era is known as the classical age because it marked significant developments in art, architecture, literature, and science. These fields flourished particularly during the reign of Chandragupta II.

items.title: Who were some great figures of this period?
items.explanation: Great figures include King Chandragupta II (also known as Vikramaditya) and his father Samudragupta, whose achievements are celebrated in inscriptions like the prayāga praśhasti. They fought wars to unify the Earth under their rule.
